verdict.rationale: The evidence shows E2B is operated through SDK calls (Sandbox.create, runCode, files, commands) and an imperative CLI, not through natural-language commands. Hosting third-party agents like Claude Code (whose natural-language interface belongs to that agent) and wiring an LLM's tool use to E2B are developer building blocks or host-side capabilities, not E2B's own natural-language control. The llms.txt file only makes the docs readable by AI and does not let anyone operate the product.
